refinement_eligibility: global if base turn_chunks>1; otherwise outcome-only if existing qualification questions and null outcome; pipeline failures retained as explicit abstentions
preserved: Every original turn label, source transcript, split and human answer; no new human labels or target labels in requests
global_pass: One independent whole-call metadata judgment replaces contradictory chunk globals
qualification_pass: Unchanged qualification guide; outcome is independent of hook presence
review_triage: Additional evidence-gap/actionable breakdown; original complete-call review remains visible
novelty_selection: Minimize development known-topic false positives subject to preserving baseline withheld-topic hits. Tie: fewer lexical overrides, then higher threshold and margin. Always show recall and false positives together.
test_status: Previously inspected exploratory comparison. Freeze selected novelty policy after development and before test refinement.

development_probe.reason: Global evidence row repetition and noncanonical qualification uncertainty paths; fixed-key evidence and constrained uncertainty added before this run.
